question: Find the names and types of cards illustrated by artists who have also created incredibly powerful foils (where both cardKingdomFoilId and cardKingdomId are not null), that belong to sets released after '2015-01-01', and are banned in any format. Return results ordered by the card's converted mana cost in descending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T1."XCL_049", T1."XCL_071"
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1."XCL_063" = T2."XCL_099"
INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1."XCL_072" = T3."XCL_086"
WHERE T2."XCL_112" > '2015-01-01'
  AND T3."XCL_085" = 'Banned'
  AND T1."XCL_002" IN (
      SELECT "XCL_002" FROM cards
      WHERE "XCL_006" IS NOT NULL AND "XCL_007" IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY T1."XCL_011" DESC
